lines.trans: This is the first time I've ever seen a film driven so completely by the woman.
Because the whistle sparks the imagination, the thick mosaic actually works—and clears every rule!
Only because of her could we film something like this — let's bet everything on this release!
You're coming home awfully late.
Mother, I've decided to go study in Italy after all.
I cannot possibly put together that kind of money for you.
That's fine, because I earned it myself today — my very first job.
How on earth did you get this much cash?!

words.gram: Past た-form of する (to do/happen).

lines.trans: I performed in an adult video.
Instead of relying on a man I've never met, I want to live by my own hands. I'm sorry.
My daughter was tricked — they brainwashed her!
I will sue them! Above all, stop them from selling that video at once!

meanings.note: Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 初めてですよ、こんなに女性主導の作品は。
examples.trans: This is the first time I've ever seen a film driven so completely by the woman.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.

examples.text: 目がダメなら耳だ。トシ、笛を買ってきてくれ。
examples.trans: If the eyes are off-limits, we aim for the ears. Toshi, go buy me a whistle.

examples.text: は？笛？もうちょっと説明してくれよ、どんな笛だよ！
examples.trans: Huh?! A whistle?! Give me a little more explanation — what kind of whistle?!
Alright, alright, I get it... a whistle...

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.

examples.text: 笛の音で想像する分、効果的だよ。規制委員会の規定にもクリアしてる。
examples.trans: Because the whistle sparks the imagination, the thick mosaic actually works—and clears every rule!

examples.text: そんなことより、次の作品どうなってんだ？まだ規制委員会とモメてんのか？
examples.trans: More importantly, how's your next release coming? Still feuding with the regulation commission?

examples.text: そんなバカな…そもそも我々は規制委員会に加盟していない！
examples.trans: That's absurd — we aren't even members of your regulation commission in the first place!

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.note: Filler or polite attention-getter.

examples.text: あの、ちょっとよろしいですか。
examples.trans: Excuse me, do you have a moment?

examples.text: あの、実は相談があります。
examples.trans: Um, actually I have something to ask you.

meanings.note: Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
Plain い-adjective describing either late timing or slow speed.

examples.text: 今日は帰りが遅いです。
この電車は少し遅いですね。
examples.trans: This train is a little slow, isn't it?

meanings.note: Standard gender-neutral 'I' in polite and business Japanese.

meanings.en: go forward; work out well (いけます = 'it will work!')
meanings.note: Written in kana for figurative headway: いけます! ('this can go / this will work!'), 思いどおりにいかない ('does not go as hoped').

examples.text: この企画ならいけます！
examples.trans: With this plan, it will work!

examples.text: 仕事がうまくいっています。

meanings.en: to think; to feel; to believe
meanings.note: Often follows quotative と to express an opinion or belief.

examples.text: それはいいと思います。

そんな.gloss: such; that kind of; that much

meanings.note: Before たくさん, means 'that huge an amount'.

examples.text: そんな話は知りません。
examples.trans: I do not know such a story.

examples.text: そんな高いものは買えません。
examples.trans: I cannot buy something that expensive.

meanings.note: Polite/standard form of 金 (かね) with honorific prefix お.

できる.gloss: be built; open; be able to

meanings.en: come into existence; be completed; can do
meanings.note: With buildings or stores (店ができる), means a new shop has been built or opened.

examples.text: 駅前に新しいカフェができました。
examples.trans: A new café opened in front of the station.

examples.text: 日本語が少しできます。
examples.trans: I can speak a little Japanese.

meanings.note: Polite/dialectal negative ending, especially in ～ません.

examples.text: 平気です、自分で働いてきたから。私、初めて働いてきたの。
examples.trans: That's fine, because I earned it myself today — my very first job.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Reflexive pronoun pointing back to the person under discussion.

examples.text: 自分の言葉で話します。
examples.trans: I speak in my own words.

meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.note: Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Asks about condition, outcome (どうだった), or what happened (どうしましたか).
Ichidan verb: blunt imperative 見ろ ('look!') is rough command speech.
Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.note: Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.
Read ひと when standing as an independent noun.

examples.text: 親切な人に会いました。

meanings.note: Ichidan verb.
Standard heartfelt apology.

examples.text: ごめんなさい、もうしません。
examples.trans: I'm sorry, I won't do it again.

examples.text: 娘はだまされたんです、洗脳されたんですよ！
examples.trans: My daughter was tricked — they brainwashed her!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Attaches to the irrealis (a-stem) of godan verbs.

examples.trans: I was called by the teacher.

examples.text: 私訴えますから！とにかく販売をやめさせてください！
examples.trans: I will sue them! Above all, stop them from selling that video at once!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.

meanings.en: bring to a halt; shut off
meanings.note: Transitive verb for stopping a car, engine, or machine.

examples.text: ここに車を止めてください。
エンジンを止めました。

meanings.note: Follows a verb's て-form or polite お + stem (お待ちください, お持ち帰りください) to make a polite request.

examples.text: ここに書いてください。

meanings.note: Contracts では; launches a decision ('well then') or opens casual farewell じゃあね.
